notes.title: Play Now!
notes.content:
[h1]It's Here! [/h1]

Its finally time to take flight and battle it out to see who is best. Simple hop on in now, take your parts and build a ship from bottom to top. Don't forget though to build up your defences you don't want your friends or foes to wipe you out too quickly! 

We have tones more blocks, features and game modes coming in the future so don't get too excited all at once as we'll be bringing them as we move forward though early access. That also means if you think something could be improved or changed, let us know we would love to know and learn where we could learn and improve!

[h2]So lets do this, Tekkers Take Flight![/h2]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest is live!
notes.content:
[h1]And we have liftoff![/h1]

This is an Alpha play test of Space Tek, we're super happy to have finally got to a point where we believe we can show our game to eager players just before the game gets released this Sunday!

The reason for this early test is so that we can gauge feedback on both the gameplay and functionality of our game along with seeking out any potential bugs that players will encounter which haven't been found yet.

With any valuable feedback and bugs we can take a note of these and quickly turn around any key issues before release so we can provide you with the best experience for the launch this Sunday

notes.title: Alpha Playtest Signups!
notes.content:
[h1]Friday 13th August, 
[/h1]

That's the date everyone will be able to get hold of our Alpha Test build, joining other alpha Tek's from around the universe (aliens maybe included). Simply head to the store page and click request access, its as simple as that to join us on our first open playtest. 

We can't wait to see you all there!
